name: @forma/surveys
description: Forma-surveys is a helper library to embed surveys into your application.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "ESM,UMD" "vp build --watch --mode dev" "BUILD_UMD=true vp build --watch --mode dev"
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 vp build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 BUILD_UMD=true vp build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:analyze: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 ANALYZE=true vp build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 vp build --mode dev && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.i18n:generate: dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx lingo.dev@latest run && dotenv -e ../../.env -- npx lingo.dev@latest lockfile --force
